title: Braided Quilt Leather Mini Tote
description: A compact tote in soft black leather with a braided chevron quilted texture across the body. Rolled top handles are knotted through silver-tone eyelets, and a zip top keeps everything secure. A small leather patch on the front adds a finishing detail.
seo_description: Small black quilted leather tote with braided texture, knotted rolled handles and a secure zip top closure.
